= Source line options
:source-highlighter: rouge

== Number forms

[source,rust,linenums]
----
fn positional() {}
fn second() {}
----

[source%linenums,rust,start=10]
----
fn ten() {}
fn eleven() {}
----

[source,rust,options=linenums,start=invalid]
----
fn invalid_start() {}
----

== Highlight selectors

[source,rust,highlight="2;4"]
----
fn one() {}
fn two() {}
fn three() {}
fn four() {}
----

[source,rust,linenums,start=20,highlight="20;22"]
----
fn twenty() {}
fn twenty_one() {}
fn twenty_two() {}
----

[source,rust,highlight="1..4;!2"]
----
fn range_one() {}
fn range_two() {}
fn range_three() {}
fn range_four() {}
----

[source,rust,highlight="3-"]
----
fn open_one() {}
fn open_two() {}
fn open_three() {}
fn open_four() {}
----

== Source forms

[source,,linenums,highlight=2]
----
plain one
plain two
----

[source%linenums,rust,highlight=2]
fn paragraph_one() {}
fn paragraph_two() {}

[source,rust,linenums,highlight=2]
----
fn callout_one() {} <1>
fn callout_two() {} <2>
----
<1> First callout.
<2> Second callout.

== Document options

:source-linenums-option:

[source,rust]
----
fn global_one() {}
fn global_two() {}
----

:source-linenums-option!:

[source,rust]
----
fn after_unset() {}
----

[source%nowrap,rust]
----
fn local_nowrap_with_a_long_line_that_must_not_wrap_in_html_but_can_wrap_in_pdf() {}
----

:prewrap!:

[source,rust]
----
fn global_nowrap_with_a_long_line_that_must_not_wrap_in_html_but_can_wrap_in_pdf() {}
----
